lines.hook: Lamine Yamal has won the Kopa Trophy again. Our ballot went to Cubarsí.
stats: Three in a row. Nobody had won it three times before.
Twenty-four goals and seventeen assists, before a torn hamstring in April.
Ninety on his EA FC twenty-seven card, the only nominee at ninety.
lines.contrast: Our ballot put Pau Cubarsí first: every minute of a World Cup win, and FIFA's Young Player Award.
lines.quote: Yamal won the Kopa, as expected. Cubarsí had already won the World Cup's version of it.
